scope:
Keep raw contacts; separate sub0.01mm interface features from deep overlaps.

A morphological erosion by an axis-aligned0.01mm cube tests whether a contact
can contain such a cube. This is a numerical feature-scale screen, never a
claim of physical clearance, printed fit or a global penetration-depth bound.
